description.value: Holland Shopping Centre is a long-established Dutch specialty import store serving the Dutch-Canadian community since 1958, stocking an extensive range of Dutch candies, stroopwafels, cookies, cheese, baking mixes, beverages, and giftware. Founded by John and Helen de Haas and now owned by Tako Slump, the shop has operated from its current Columbia Street East location since 2009 and also runs a mail-order service reaching customers across North America and beyond. A touring cyclist stopping in New Westminster will find a distinctive one-stop source for Dutch specialty snacks unavailable in ordinary grocery stores.
